intent.raw_query: Maldives honeymoon for 2, $5000 budget, snorkeling and luxury resorts, March 2026

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise
experiences.description: Embark on a traditional Maldivian wooden boat (dhoni) decorated with flowers and candles for a private sunset cruise with your partner. Enjoy champagne, fresh tropical fruits, and canapés while watching the sky turn golden over the Indian Ocean. Dolphins often accompany the boat, making it an unforgettable romantic experience.

experiences.name: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari
experiences.description: Join a guided snorkeling safari through the vibrant coral gardens of the Baa Atoll UNESCO Biosphere Reserve. Swim alongside manta rays, sea turtles, reef sharks, and thousands of tropical fish in crystal-clear turquoise waters. A marine biologist guide explains the ecosystem and ensures a safe, educational, and awe-inspiring underwater adventure.

experiences.name: Underwater Restaurant Dinner for Two
experiences.description: Dine in one of the world's most iconic underwater restaurants, surrounded by panoramic views of the reef and its marine life. Enjoy a curated five-course fine dining menu featuring fresh Maldivian seafood, lobster, and international cuisine while nurse sharks and colorful fish glide past the glass walls. The ultimate luxury honeymoon dining experience.
experiences.location: Rangali Island, South Ari Atoll, Maldives

experiences.name: Maldivian Cooking Class & Local Island Visit
experiences.description: Visit the inhabited local island of Maafushi and immerse yourself in authentic Maldivian culture. Take a hands-on cooking class with a local family learning to prepare traditional dishes like mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya fish soup, and roshi flatbread. Explore the island's colorful streets, visit a local mosque, and enjoy your freshly cooked meal together.
experiences.location: Maafushi Island, South Malé Atoll, Maldives

experiences.name: Bioluminescent Beach Night Experience
experiences.description: After dark, walk along a secluded beach on Vaadhoo Island where the shoreline glows with stunning blue bioluminescent plankton, creating a magical 'sea of stars' effect. Combine this with a private beachside setup featuring a canopy bed, rose petals, lanterns, and a chilled bottle of wine for the most romantic and otherworldly honeymoon memory imaginable.

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Maldives
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

experiences.name: Bioluminescent Beach Night Experience
experiences.description: After dark, walk along a secluded beach on Vaadhoo Island where the shoreline glows with stunning blue bioluminescent plankton, creating a magical 'sea of stars' effect. Combine this with a private beachside setup featuring a canopy bed, rose petals, lanterns, and a chilled bottle of wine for the most romantic and otherworldly honeymoon memory imaginable.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled - flight in transit
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled - flight in transit
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 22:30 via Flight UA. Clear immigration and customs, collect luggage, and arrange speedboat or ferry transfer to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in, freshen up, and take a quiet stroll along the beachfront to soak in the warm ocean breeze and starlit sky.

meals.breakfast: On the flight
meals.lunch: On the flight
meals.dinner: Light snack from airport kiosk or convenience store before transfer (budget ~$5-8 USD)

day_by_day.notes: Late arrival — keep Day 1 completely relaxed. Pre-arrange your resort transfer in advance to avoid delays at night. Pack a small carry-on snack for the journey. Exchange a small amount of currency at the airport for tips and local purchases.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and recover from travel. Enjoy a leisurely breakfast at the resort. Take a slow walk along the beachfront to orient yourself with the resort layout, nearby sandbanks, and house reef access points.
day_by_day.afternoon: Grab your snorkel gear (rent from resort for ~$10/day or bring your own) and explore the resort's house reef. Spot colorful coral gardens, reef fish, sea turtles, and rays right from the beach — no boat needed. This is one of the most budget-friendly snorkeling options available.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the sunset from the beach with a fresh coconut from a local vendor (~$2-3). Dine at the resort's casual beachside restaurant and enjoy a simple local Maldivian meal.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast buffet or included meal plan — enjoy fresh tropical fruits, eggs, and local short eats
meals.lunch: Pack a light picnic-style lunch from the resort cafe — sandwiches and juice (~$8-12)
meals.dinner: Beachside restaurant at the resort — try Garudhiya (tuna soup) with rice and roshi flatbread (~$12-18)

day_by_day.notes: Ask the resort front desk about free or low-cost house reef snorkeling times and any complimentary gear included with your room. Wear reef-safe sunscreen to protect the coral ecosystem.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early for a sunrise yoga session on the beach (many resorts offer free or low-cost sessions). Afterward, enjoy a walk on the sandbank at low tide — a magical, romantic experience unique to the Maldives.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join a budget group snorkeling excursion organized by the resort or a local dive center. Visit nearby coral reefs and snorkel spots teeming with marine life including parrotfish, clownfish, and moray eels (~$25-40 per person for a group trip).
day_by_day.evening: Bioluminescent Beach Night Experience on Vaadhoo Island — walk along the glowing shoreline where phytoplankton light up the waves in electric blue. One of the most breathtaking and romantic natural phenomena in the world. Check with the resort for transfer arrangements.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — fresh papaya, yogurt, and Maldivian mas huni (tuna and coconut) with flatbread
meals.lunch: Local tea house (sai hotel) near the island if accessible — hedhikaa snacks and short eats (~$4-6)
meals.dinner: Pack a romantic picnic dinner from the resort to enjoy near the bioluminescent beach, or dine at a local restaurant on Vaadhoo Island (~$10-15)

day_by_day.notes: The bioluminescent experience is best viewed on darker nights away from artificial light. Bring a light jacket as ocean breezes can be cool after dark. This is a must-do romantic activity — perfect for honeymoon couples.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning dolphin watching cruise — many local operators offer shared boat trips at sunrise when dolphins are most active (~$20-30 per person). A magical and budget-friendly experience on the open ocean.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to resort and relax on the beachfront. Explore the resort's shallow lagoon by paddleboard or kayak (often complimentary or ~$10/hour). Look for starfish and small reef sharks in the crystal-clear water.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic beach dinner setup — some resorts offer a simple candlelit beach dinner at a lower price point than full luxury packages (~$40-60 for two). Alternatively, dine at the resort restaurant and take an evening walk under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast before dolphin cruise — grab a banana, bread roll, and tea from the resort cafe
meals.lunch: Resort restaurant — grilled fish with salad and fresh lime juice (~$10-15)
meals.dinner: Budget candlelit beach dinner or resort restaurant — seafood platter with local rice and vegetables (~$15-25 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Book dolphin watching tours the night before to secure spots. Sunrise trips are cooler and offer better dolphin activity. Bring a waterproof camera or GoPro for the lagoon exploration.

day_by_day.morning: Visit a local inhabited island nearby by public ferry or dhoni boat (~$1-5 USD). Explore the local village, visit the Friday mosque, and browse small shops selling handmade crafts and lacquerware — an authentic cultural experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Snorkel at a new reef site near the local island, often accessible independently or via a short boat ride. Local reefs near inhabited islands are frequently less crowded and equally stunning.
day_by_day.evening: Return to resort before sunset. Enjoy a couples' spa treatment — look for budget spa packages or off-peak discounts (~$30-50 per person for a 30-minute massage). Watch the sunset from the jetty.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — eggs, toast, fresh juice, and tropical fruit
meals.lunch: Local tea house on the inhabited island — authentic Maldivian curry, roshi, and sweet black tea (~$3-6 per person)
meals.dinner: Resort restaurant — tuna curry with steamed rice and coconut sambal (~$12-18)

day_by_day.notes: Dress modestly when visiting local islands — cover shoulders and knees out of respect for local Islamic culture. Bikinis are not permitted on local island beaches. This is one of the best budget cultural experiences in the Maldives.

day_by_day.morning: Morning snorkeling session at the house reef focusing on the deeper drop-off section where larger marine life like nurse sharks and eagle rays are often spotted. Go early when visibility is best.
day_by_day.afternoon: Rent a bicycle from the resort or local shop (~$5-8/day) and explore the island at your own pace. Find hidden beach spots, visit local cafes, and enjoy the slow island pace.
day_by_day.evening: DIY romantic sunset picnic on a secluded beach section. Pick up fresh fruit, local snacks, and drinks from a nearby shop. Lay out a sarong, watch the sky turn orange and pink, and enjoy the moment together.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast at resort — yogurt parfait with granola and tropical fruits
meals.lunch: Resort cafe — fish burger or wrap with fresh coconut water (~$8-12)
meals.dinner: Picnic dinner on the beach — local snacks, fresh fruit, cheese, crackers, and juice purchased from a local shop (~$10-15 total)

day_by_day.notes: Check with the resort about the best times for spotting nurse sharks at the house reef — early morning and late afternoon are typically most productive. Bring reef-safe insect repellent for evening beach time.

day_by_day.morning: Full-day snorkeling trip to a famous nearby snorkeling site such as a manta ray cleaning station or whale shark hotspot (seasonal). Book through the resort or a local operator for a shared group trip (~$35-55 per person including lunch).
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the snorkeling excursion — explore multiple reef sites, swim through coral tunnels, and drift snorkel along a current-fed reef wall. These group trips typically visit 2-3 different spots.
day_by_day.evening: Return to resort by late afternoon. Enjoy a relaxing evening with a cold drink at the resort bar (happy hour if available). Write postcards, journal your experiences, or simply sit by the ocean.

meals.breakfast: Hearty resort breakfast before the full-day trip — fuel up with eggs, fruit, and carbohydrates
meals.lunch: Included on the boat trip — typically a packed lunch of sandwiches, fruit, and water
meals.dinner: Resort restaurant — splurge slightly on a grilled lobster or fresh catch of the day to celebrate the midpoint of your trip (~$20-30)

day_by_day.notes: Whale shark and manta ray sightings depend on season and luck — March is generally a good month in the Maldives for both. Always maintain a respectful distance from marine life and never touch or chase animals.

day_by_day.morning: Rest and recovery morning. Sleep in, enjoy a slow breakfast, and spend time reading or relaxing in a hammock by the beach. A necessary rest day after the full-day excursion.
day_by_day.afternoon: Snorkeling photography session — if you have an underwater camera, spend the afternoon capturing the vibrant coral and fish at the house reef. Alternatively, take a free-diving lesson offered by the resort (~$20-30 for a beginner session).
day_by_day.evening: Stargazing on the beach — the Maldives has minimal light pollution and offers spectacular views of the Milky Way. Lay out a beach mat and spend the evening identifying constellations together.

meals.breakfast: Late resort breakfast — pancakes with fresh mango, eggs, and coffee
meals.lunch: Light meal at resort cafe — fresh fruit smoothie bowl and a sandwich (~$8-10)
meals.dinner: Budget-friendly resort set menu or daily special — usually the most economical option on the restaurant menu (~$12-20)

day_by_day.notes: Ask resort staff about the best stargazing spots away from resort lighting. Download a free star map app like SkyMap or Star Walk before your trip. This is an incredibly romantic and free evening activity.

day_by_day.morning: Take a guided snorkeling tour to a shipwreck or artificial reef nearby — these unique sites attract dense marine life and offer a different snorkeling experience from coral reefs (~$20-35 for a guided group trip).
day_by_day.afternoon: Back at the resort, try stand-up paddleboarding across the lagoon. The calm, shallow turquoise water is perfect for beginners. Paddle to the sandbank and spend time walking on the white sand surrounded by ocean.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic in-room or beachfront dinner — order room service or a takeaway from the resort restaurant and set up your own private dining experience on your beachfront terrace with candles and music.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — fresh tropical juice, toast, and local short eats
meals.lunch: Snack on the boat — bring your own packed snacks to save money during the excursion
meals.dinner: In-room or terrace dining — order a seafood pasta, grilled fish, or local curry from room service (~$15-25 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Creating your own private dining experience is far more budget-friendly than booking an official resort 'romantic dining package' which can cost $150-300+. A few candles and your own playlist create the same magical atmosphere.

day_by_day.morning: Morning fishing trip with a local fisherman — traditional Maldivian line fishing from a small dhoni boat at sunrise is an authentic cultural experience and very affordable (~$15-25 per person). Often includes keeping your catch.
day_by_day.afternoon: Have your morning catch cooked at the resort or a local restaurant — many places will prepare your fresh fish for a small fee. Spend the rest of the afternoon relaxing on the beach and swimming in the lagoon.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a local Bodu Beru cultural performance if available — traditional Maldivian drumming and dance performed in the evenings at some resorts or community centers. Often free or very low cost.

meals.breakfast: Light pre-fishing breakfast — coffee, bread, and fruit
meals.lunch: Your freshly caught fish prepared by the resort kitchen or local cook — a truly memorable meal (~$5-10 cooking fee)
meals.dinner: Local tea house or resort restaurant — Maldivian rihaakuru (fish paste) with rice and vegetables (~$8-15)

day_by_day.notes: Traditional Maldivian fishing is done without bait using a simple line and hook — it's surprisingly effective and very fun. This activity is perfect for couples looking for a unique, authentic experience on a budget.

day_by_day.morning: Final major snorkeling excursion — revisit your favorite reef site or explore a new one recommended by the resort dive center. Spend extra time underwater and take mental photographs of your favorite moments.
day_by_day.afternoon: Souvenir shopping on the nearest local island or resort gift shop. Look for handmade lacquerware (laajehun), woven mats, and locally produced coconut oil products. Bargain respectfully at local shops.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset dhoni cruise — a traditional wooden boat cruise at sunset is one of the most romantic experiences in the Maldives. Group tours are very affordable (~$20-30 per person) and include drinks and snacks.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — full spread to fuel the morning snorkeling
meals.lunch: Resort cafe — light lunch of salad, grilled fish, and fresh juice (~$10-15)
meals.dinner: Special dinner at resort restaurant to celebrate near the end of your trip — order a sharing platter of local seafood (~$25-40 for two)

day_by_day.notes: The sunset dhoni cruise is the perfect penultimate evening activity — romantic, scenic, and budget-friendly. Many operators include sparkling wine or mocktails. Book at least one day in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Final snorkeling session at the house reef — say goodbye to your favorite fish and coral formations. Take a final swim in the lagoon and collect a few memories (photographs only — never collect shells or coral).
day_by_day.afternoon: Pack your bags, settle your resort bill, and spend a relaxed afternoon by the pool or beach. Write in your travel journal, edit your best underwater photos, and soak in the last hours of paradise.
day_by_day.evening: Final romantic dinner at the resort — treat yourselves to a slightly special meal to celebrate your honeymoon trip. Many resorts offer a complimentary honeymoon setup (rose petals, cake) if requested in advance — ask!

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — enjoy every bite knowing it's your last morning meal in paradise
meals.lunch: Light lunch at resort cafe — keep it simple with a salad and fresh coconut water
meals.dinner: Special farewell dinner at resort — grilled seafood, local desserts, and a mocktail or local juice toast (~$30-50 for two)

day_by_day.notes: Inform the resort in advance that you are on your honeymoon — many resorts provide complimentary romantic touches such as flower arrangements, fruit platters, or a small cake at no extra charge. Always worth asking!

day_by_day.morning: Wake up for one final sunrise on the beach — a quiet, private moment to reflect on your incredible 13-day Maldives honeymoon. Take a final walk along the shoreline barefoot.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort and arrange transfer to Velana International Airport. Allow plenty of time for the speedboat or ferry transfer plus airport check-in procedures (arrive at airport at least 2-3 hours before departure).
day_by_day.evening: Depart from Velana International Airport with memories of turquoise lagoons, glowing beaches, vibrant coral reefs, and a honeymoon to last a lifetime.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — enjoy a full meal before your journey home
meals.lunch: Airport restaurant or cafe at Velana International Airport — local snacks or an international meal (~$10-15)
meals.dinner: On the flight home

day_by_day.notes: Keep your departure transfer well-organized — speedboat and seaplane transfers must be booked in advance and operate on fixed schedules. Double-check transfer timing with the resort the night before. Keep all receipts for travel insurance purposes. Carry reef-safe sunscreen, underwater camera memory cards, and any liquid souvenirs in checked luggage.

day_by_day.morning: N/A – Late night arrival
day_by_day.afternoon: N/A – Late night arrival
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. Complete immigration and customs formalities. Meet the Aegean Bliss Resort transfer representative and board the arranged speedboat or seaplane transfer to the resort. Check in to your Beachfront villa, enjoy a welcome drink and a light midnight snack prepared by the resort. Settle in and rest.

meals.breakfast: N/A – In-flight meal
meals.lunch: N/A – In-flight meal
meals.dinner: Light welcome snack platter provided by Aegean Bliss Resort upon arrival (complimentary check-in amenity)

day_by_day.notes: Pack a carry-on with essentials (swimwear, toiletries, change of clothes) for easy access after the late arrival. Confirm transfer arrangements with the resort at least 48 hours before landing. Speedboat transfers typically run until midnight; confirm timing in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely start. Wake up to your first Maldivian sunrise from your beachfront villa. Take a slow morning walk along the private beach, dip your toes in the lagoon, and get acquainted with the resort grounds. Head to the resort's main restaurant for a full breakfast with ocean views.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon at leisure exploring the resort's house reef with snorkeling gear (available from the resort's water sports center). Discover colorful fish and coral formations just steps from your villa. Take a break with tropical cocktails at the overwater beach bar. Optional: Book a couples' spa treatment at the resort spa to recover from jet lag (budget approximately $80–$120 per person for a 60-minute massage).
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic candlelit dinner at the resort's beachfront restaurant. Watch the stars from your villa's private terrace and celebrate the start of your Maldives honeymoon.

meals.breakfast: Buffet breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort's main restaurant – included or ~$25–$35 per person
meals.lunch: Light bites and fresh tropical fruit at the beach bar – ~$20–$30 per person
meals.dinner: Beachfront restaurant at Aegean Bliss Resort – set menu or à la carte, ~$60–$90 per couple

day_by_day.notes: This is a gentle recovery day after your late arrival. Avoid overplanning. Pick up a resort activity schedule from the front desk to plan the rest of your stay. Rent snorkeling gear from the water sports desk (~$10–$15/day or free with some packages).

day_by_day.morning: After breakfast, head to the resort's water sports center for an introductory guided snorkeling session around the house reef. A resort snorkeling guide will point out sea turtles, reef sharks, and vibrant coral formations. This is perfect preparation for the bigger snorkeling excursions later in the trip.
day_by_day.afternoon: Join the resort's afternoon lagoon kayaking session. Paddle through the calm turquoise waters surrounding the island, explore hidden sandbanks, and enjoy views of the overwater villas from the water. Return to the villa for a refreshing outdoor shower and downtime on your private beach loungers.
day_by_day.evening: Book the Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise experience. Embark on a traditional Maldivian wooden dhoni decorated with flowers and candles for a private romantic cruise. Watch the golden sunset over the Indian Ocean with your partner, sip on sparkling wine, and enjoy canapés aboard. A truly magical honeymoon moment.

meals.breakfast: Buffet or à la carte breakfast at the resort – ~$25–$35 per person
meals.lunch: Casual lunch at the resort's poolside café – grilled fish, salads, and fresh juices – ~$25–$40 per couple
meals.dinner: Dinner back at the resort after the dhoni cruise – try the resort's seafood grill for fresh catch of the day – ~$70–$100 per couple

day_by_day.notes: The Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise typically lasts 1.5–2 hours and costs approximately $150–$250 per couple. Book through the resort concierge the day before. Bring a light wrap or shawl as it can get breezy on the water at sunset.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning: Join the Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari in the Baa Atoll UNESCO Biosphere Reserve. Depart by speedboat with a professional marine biologist guide who will lead you through the most vibrant coral gardens in the Maldives. Spot manta rays, whale sharks (seasonal), colorful reef fish, and pristine coral formations. This is the highlight snorkeling experience of the trip.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort by early afternoon. Relax and decompress on your private beachfront with a good book and cold drinks. Optional: Visit the resort's dive center to discuss a beginner scuba diving discovery course if you're curious about going deeper (~$100–$150 per person).
day_by_day.evening: Casual evening at the resort. Enjoy sundowners at the overwater bar, then head for dinner at the resort's Asian fusion restaurant for a change of cuisine.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast at the resort before the safari departure – grab a grab-and-go option from the resort café – ~$15–$20 per person
meals.lunch: Light lunch provided on the snorkeling safari boat (typically included) or snack at the resort on return – ~$10–$20 per person
meals.dinner: Asian fusion restaurant at Aegean Bliss Resort – sushi, Thai-inspired dishes, and Maldivian seafood – ~$60–$90 per couple

day_by_day.notes: The Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari costs approximately $80–$120 per person and lasts 3–4 hours. Baa Atoll is best visited between May and November for manta rays, but reef snorkeling is excellent year-round. Bring reef-safe sunscreen, an underwater camera, and a rash guard. Book at least 2 days in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Relaxed morning – sleep in, enjoy breakfast in bed (order room service to your beachfront villa for a special treat, ~$40–$60 per couple). Spend the morning lounging on your private beach, swimming in the crystal-clear lagoon, and enjoying each other's company with no agenda.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the Maldivian Cooking Class & Local Island experience. Take a short boat ride to the inhabited local island of Maafushi. Explore the local village, visit a traditional Maldivian home, browse local shops for souvenirs, and participate in a hands-on cooking class learning to prepare authentic Maldivian dishes like mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya (fish soup), and roshi (flatbread).
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort by late afternoon. Freshen up and enjoy a quiet, romantic evening. Dine at the resort's main restaurant using the new Maldivian recipes you learned as inspiration – try ordering the local fish curry to compare!

meals.breakfast: Room service breakfast at your beachfront villa – ~$40–$60 per couple (special treat)
meals.lunch: Traditional Maldivian lunch included as part of the cooking class experience on Maafushi – ~included in tour cost
meals.dinner: Resort main restaurant – Maldivian-inspired menu with fresh seafood and local flavors – ~$65–$90 per couple

day_by_day.notes: The Maldivian Cooking Class & Local Island Visit costs approximately $100–$150 per couple and lasts about 4–5 hours. Dress modestly when visiting the local island (cover shoulders and knees out of respect for local customs). Bring cash for local souvenir shopping – small shops may not accept cards.

day_by_day.morning: Morning yoga or meditation session on the beach (check resort schedule – often complimentary). Follow with a refreshing swim in the lagoon. After breakfast, visit the resort's water sports center to try stand-up paddleboarding (SUP) or windsurfing for something new and fun.
day_by_day.afternoon: Afternoon at the resort spa for a couples' treatment package. Choose from traditional Maldivian healing therapies using coconut oil and local herbs, or a classic deep tissue massage. This is a luxurious mid-trip pampering session. Book the 90-minute couples' package for the best value (~$150–$200 per couple).
day_by_day.evening: Dress up for a special romantic dinner. Request a private beach dining setup from the resort concierge – a table set on the sand with lanterns, flowers, and a personalized menu. This is an iconic Maldivian honeymoon experience (~$150–$250 per couple, often bookable as a resort package).

meals.breakfast: Healthy breakfast at the resort – açaí bowls, fresh tropical fruit, and smoothies – ~$25–$35 per person
meals.lunch: Light poolside lunch – club sandwiches, fresh salads, and cold-pressed juices – ~$30–$45 per couple
meals.dinner: Private beach dining experience – personalized set menu with fresh lobster, champagne, and dessert – ~$150–$250 per couple

day_by_day.notes: Book the private beach dinner at least 2–3 days in advance through the concierge. Specify any dietary restrictions or preferences. The spa couples' package should also be booked ahead. March weather in the Maldives is typically warm and calm – ideal for outdoor dining.

day_by_day.morning: Mid-trip adventure day! Join a morning big game fishing excursion arranged by the resort. Head out into the deep ocean waters with an experienced local fisherman and try your hand at trolling for tuna, barracuda, or mahi-mahi. The experience gives you a taste of authentic Maldivian fishing culture (~$80–$120 per couple for 2–3 hours).
day_by_day.afternoon: Return with your catch and ask the resort chef to prepare your fish for lunch – a truly farm-to-table (ocean-to-table) Maldivian experience! Spend the rest of the afternoon relaxing by the infinity pool with cocktails and enjoying panoramic ocean views.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy the Underwater Restaurant Dinner for Two. Dine in one of the world's most iconic underwater restaurants, surrounded by panoramic views of the vibrant marine ecosystem. Watch reef sharks, rays, and tropical fish glide past as you enjoy a gourmet multi-course meal. A truly once-in-a-lifetime honeymoon experience.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast before the fishing trip – continental spread at the resort café – ~$20–$25 per person
meals.lunch: Ocean-to-table lunch prepared by the resort chef using your morning catch – ~$40–$60 per couple (chef fee)
meals.dinner: Underwater Restaurant Dinner for Two – multi-course gourmet menu with wine pairing – ~$200–$350 per couple (reserve well in advance)

day_by_day.notes: The Underwater Restaurant experience is the most premium activity of the trip. Reserve at least 1 week in advance as availability is very limited. Smart casual dress code applies. The fishing excursion is best done early morning when fish are most active. Bring motion sickness medication if you're prone to seasickness.

day_by_day.morning: Slow, peaceful morning. Enjoy a late breakfast and spend time reading, journaling, or simply sitting on your villa's private beach watching the ocean. This is a deliberate rest day to recharge mid-trip. Take a gentle morning swim in the lagoon.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the resort's coral nursery program (if available) – many Maldivian resorts run coral restoration initiatives where guests can plant coral fragments and contribute to reef conservation. This meaningful activity connects your visit to the environment you've been enjoying. Alternatively, take a glass-bottom boat tour to observe marine life without getting wet (~$30–$50 per couple).
day_by_day.evening: Casual evening – grab drinks at the resort's beach bar and watch the sunset from the shoreline. Have a relaxed dinner at the resort's casual dining venue – no dress code, just good food and good company.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely late breakfast at the resort – eggs benedict, fresh pastries, tropical juices – ~$25–$35 per person
meals.lunch: Light snack at the beach bar – fresh coconut, fruit platters, and a sandwich – ~$20–$30 per couple
meals.dinner: Casual resort restaurant – wood-fired pizzas, fresh pasta, and Maldivian fish dishes – ~$50–$75 per couple

day_by_day.notes: Day 8 is intentionally low-key to prevent activity fatigue. The Maldives is best enjoyed slowly. Check with the resort about their coral conservation program – participation is often free or involves a small donation to the program.

day_by_day.morning: Morning snorkeling session – this time explore a different section of the house reef or join the resort's guided reef snorkeling tour to a nearby coral pinnacle. With your snorkeling skills now well-practiced, you'll notice and appreciate far more marine life than on Day 2. Look out for octopus, moray eels, and eagle rays.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a resort-organized dolphin watching cruise in the early afternoon. The waters around the Maldives are home to spinner dolphins and bottlenose dolphins that frequently frolic alongside boats. A joyful, uplifting experience perfect for couples (~$50–$80 per couple for 1.5–2 hours).
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort and enjoy happy hour at the overwater bar (typically 5–7 PM with discounted cocktails). Watch the sunset from the bar's deck. Have dinner at the resort's seafood restaurant – order the fresh lobster or grilled reef fish.

meals.breakfast: Resort buffet breakfast – full spread with live cooking stations – ~$25–$35 per person
meals.lunch: Light lunch on the dolphin cruise boat (snacks provided) or quick bite at the resort on return – ~$15–$25 per person
meals.dinner: Resort seafood restaurant – fresh lobster, grilled fish, and prawn curry – ~$80–$110 per couple

day_by_day.notes: Dolphin sightings are very common in the Maldives but not guaranteed. The best time for dolphin watching is late afternoon, but morning cruises also work well. Bring your camera with a zoom lens for great dolphin photos.

day_by_day.morning: Adventure morning – try a new water sport! Head to the water sports center for a wakeboarding or jet skiing session (~$40–$60 per 30 minutes). Alternatively, try a tandem parasailing flight for breathtaking aerial views of the atoll and your resort island from above (~$80–$100 per couple).
day_by_day.afternoon: After an action-packed morning, wind down with a quiet afternoon on your villa's private beach. Order afternoon tea delivered to your beach chairs by the resort butler (a lovely mid-range luxury touch). Read, nap, and enjoy the tranquility.
day_by_day.evening: Bioluminescent Beach Night Experience – After dark, travel to a secluded beach where the shoreline glows with stunning bioluminescent plankton. Walk hand-in-hand along the glowing blue shoreline for an otherworldly, deeply romantic experience. One of the most magical and unique natural phenomena in the world.

meals.breakfast: À la carte breakfast at the resort – avocado toast, smoked salmon, and fresh fruit – ~$25–$35 per person
meals.lunch: Poolside lunch – burgers, wraps, and fresh coconut water – ~$30–$45 per couple
meals.dinner: Early dinner at the resort before the bioluminescent experience – light Maldivian curry and rice – ~$55–$80 per couple

day_by_day.notes: The Bioluminescent Beach Night Experience on Vaadhoo Island costs approximately $80–$130 per couple and requires a boat transfer. The phenomenon is best viewed on nights with a new moon (minimal moonlight). Check lunar calendar and confirm optimal timing with the tour operator. Wear dark clothing to better see the glow. No flash photography – use long-exposure settings.

day_by_day.morning: Morning at leisure – your second-to-last full day. Sleep in, order breakfast to your villa, and spend the morning in the lagoon for one final extended snorkeling session. Take photos and video of the marine life you've come to recognize over the past 10 days. Say a mental goodbye to the house reef.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon doing some light souvenir shopping at the resort boutique and packing any items you've accumulated. Then treat yourselves to a final couples' spa treatment – a relaxing 60-minute Maldivian coconut and lime body scrub followed by a warm oil massage (~$100–$150 per couple).
day_by_day.evening: Attend any resort-organized cultural evening if available (traditional Bodu Beru drumming performance, local dance show, or fire dancing). These cultural shows are often held on resort islands and are a wonderful way to connect with Maldivian heritage. Enjoy cocktails during the performance.

meals.breakfast: Room service breakfast in bed – continental with fresh pastries and tropical juice – ~$40–$60 per couple
meals.lunch: Beach BBQ lunch at the resort (if available on Thursdays) – grilled seafood, satays, and salads – ~$40–$60 per couple
meals.dinner: Return to your favorite resort restaurant from the trip for a nostalgic final dinner – ~$70–$100 per couple

day_by_day.notes: Use this day to reflect on your favorite experiences and purchase meaningful souvenirs – Maldivian lacquerwork (laajehun), handwoven mats, and local honey make excellent gifts. Confirm your departure transfer arrangements with the concierge today.

day_by_day.morning: Final full day – wake up early one last time to watch the sunrise over the Indian Ocean from your beachfront villa. Take a long, slow walk along the beach collecting shells and memories. Have one final swim in the crystal-clear lagoon and take plenty of photos of your villa and the stunning surroundings.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check-out formalities (if departing the following day) or simply relax. Spend the afternoon at the infinity pool with cocktails. Write postcards or notes to loved ones back home. Take a final kayak paddle around the island.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner – make it special. Request a table at the resort's premier restaurant and order the chef's tasting menu or the freshest seafood available. Toast to your honeymoon, to each other, and to the incredible 12 days you've shared in paradise. After dinner, take a final barefoot walk on the beach under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Final resort buffet breakfast – enjoy every item one last time – ~$25–$35 per person
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the beach bar – keep it casual and relaxed – ~$25–$35 per couple
meals.dinner: Farewell gourmet dinner at the resort's signature restaurant – chef's tasting menu with wine – ~$120–$180 per couple

day_by_day.notes: Settle your resort bill today to avoid a rushed checkout tomorrow. Return any rented equipment (snorkel gear, fins, etc.) to the water sports center. Back up all your photos to cloud storage. Leave a tip for your villa butler and favorite resort staff – it is greatly appreciated.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning – wake up, take one last look at your beachfront view, and savor the moment. Enjoy a final breakfast at the resort. Complete checkout and transfer your luggage to the resort's departure lounge. Take a final stroll on the beach before your transfer departs.
day_by_day.afternoon: Board your resort transfer (speedboat or seaplane) back to Velana International Airport, Male. Arrive with plenty of time for check-in and security. Browse duty-free shopping at the airport for any last-minute Maldivian souvenirs (local spices, dried fish, Maldivian tea). Board your departure flight carrying 13 days of magical honeymoon memories.
day_by_day.evening: In-flight – reflect on an unforgettable Maldives honeymoon. Review your photos, plan how you'll share your memories, and start dreaming about your next adventure together.

meals.breakfast: Final breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort – make it a good one – ~$25–$35 per person
meals.lunch: Airport restaurant or lounge – light meal before departure – ~$20–$30 per person
meals.dinner: In-flight meal

day_by_day.notes: Departure transfers should be booked at least 24 hours in advance. Seaplane transfers operate only during daylight hours (approximately 6 AM – 5:30 PM) – if your flight departs late, you may need a speedboat transfer to Male and an overnight stay in Male, so plan accordingly. Reconfirm your return flight and transfer timing with the resort concierge on Day 12.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Maldives Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise
experiences.description: Embark on a traditional Maldivian wooden boat (dhoni) decorated with flowers and candles for a private sunset cruise with your partner. Enjoy champagne, fresh tropical fruits, and canapés while watching the sky turn golden over the Indian Ocean. Dolphins often accompany the boat, making it an unforgettable romantic experience.

experiences.name: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari
experiences.description: Join a guided snorkeling safari through the vibrant coral gardens of the Baa Atoll UNESCO Biosphere Reserve. Swim alongside manta rays, sea turtles, reef sharks, and thousands of tropical fish in crystal-clear turquoise waters. A marine biologist guide explains the ecosystem and ensures a safe, educational, and awe-inspiring underwater adventure.

experiences.name: Underwater Restaurant Dinner for Two
experiences.description: Dine in one of the world's most iconic underwater restaurants, surrounded by panoramic views of the reef and its marine life. Enjoy a curated five-course fine dining menu featuring fresh Maldivian seafood, lobster, and international cuisine while nurse sharks and colorful fish glide past the glass walls. The ultimate luxury honeymoon dining experience.
experiences.location: Rangali Island, South Ari Atoll, Maldives

experiences.name: Maldivian Cooking Class & Local Island Visit
experiences.description: Visit the inhabited local island of Maafushi and immerse yourself in authentic Maldivian culture. Take a hands-on cooking class with a local family learning to prepare traditional dishes like mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya fish soup, and roshi flatbread. Explore the island's colorful streets, visit a local mosque, and enjoy your freshly cooked meal together.
experiences.location: Maafushi Island, South Malé Atoll, Maldives

experiences.name: Bioluminescent Beach Night Experience
experiences.description: After dark, walk along a secluded beach on Vaadhoo Island where the shoreline glows with stunning blue bioluminescent plankton, creating a magical 'sea of stars' effect. Combine this with a private beachside setup featuring a canopy bed, rose petals, lanterns, and a chilled bottle of wine for the most romantic and otherworldly honeymoon memory imaginable.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight in transit
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — flight in transit
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 22:30 on flight UA. A dedicated Aegean Bliss Resort butler will greet you at the arrivals hall with a welcome garland and champagne. Transfer via private luxury speedboat to Aegean Bliss Resort (approximately 45–60 min scenic night transfer). Upon arrival, enjoy a moonlit welcome ceremony on the jetty with chilled towels, tropical fruit, and a signature welcome cocktail. Check into your Beachfront villa, where rose petals, a honeymoon turndown, and a complimentary bottle of Moët & Chandon await.

meals.breakfast: In-flight or airport lounge
meals.lunch: In-flight or airport lounge
meals.dinner: Light late-night honeymoon amenity platter (tropical fruits, artisan cheeses, chocolate-dipped strawberries) served in-villa by your personal butler

day_by_day.notes: Given the late arrival, no formal dining or activities are scheduled. Ensure passports, resort confirmation, and speedboat transfer vouchers are easily accessible. Inform the resort in advance of any dietary preferences or special honeymoon requests.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely start to your honeymoon. Indulge in an in-villa floating breakfast served in your private plunge pool — a curated spread of tropical fruits, freshly baked pastries, eggs Benedict, freshly squeezed juices, and barista-crafted coffee, all arranged on a flower-decorated tray. Spend time exploring your beachfront villa, the private stretch of sand, and the resort's lush grounds.
day_by_day.afternoon: Orientation snorkeling session directly from your beachfront villa's house reef. A resort snorkeling guide will provide a 30-minute briefing and equipment fitting before leading you through the vibrant coral formations and marine life just steps from your villa. Spot colourful reef fish, sea turtles, and rays in the crystal-clear lagoon. Return to the beach for a relaxing session on your private sun loungers with cold-pressed juice service.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic sunset at the resort's overwater bar, sipping handcrafted cocktails as the sky transforms into hues of orange and pink. Dinner at the resort's signature fine-dining restaurant — a multi-course tasting menu featuring Maldivian-inspired cuisine with premium ingredients such as seared lobster, line-caught tuna tartare, and coconut panna cotta, paired with a curated wine selection.

meals.breakfast: Floating in-villa pool breakfast — tropical fruits, pastries, eggs Benedict, fresh juices, barista coffee
meals.lunch: Light beachside lunch at the resort's beach grill — grilled reef fish, avocado salad, fresh coconut water
meals.dinner: Signature fine-dining restaurant — multi-course tasting menu with wine pairing (lobster, tuna tartare, coconut panna cotta)

day_by_day.notes: Day 2 is intentionally relaxed to allow recovery from travel. Confirm snorkeling guide availability with the butler the evening prior. Floating breakfast should be pre-ordered the night before.

day_by_day.morning: Begin the morning with a couples' yoga and meditation session on a private overwater platform, led by the resort's dedicated wellness instructor. The session overlooks the turquoise lagoon and is followed by a healthy green smoothie and acai bowl. Afterward, visit the resort's Aqua Spa for a 60-minute couples' deep-tissue massage using locally sourced coconut and frangipani oils.
day_by_day.afternoon: Board the resort's private catamaran for a Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari through the vibrant coral gardens of the Baa Atoll UNESCO Biosphere Reserve. A certified marine biologist guide will lead you through pristine coral formations teeming with manta rays, whale sharks (seasonal), reef sharks, sea turtles, and hundreds of tropical fish species. Snorkeling equipment, reef-safe sunscreen, and refreshments are provided on board.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the villa for a private in-villa dining experience. Your butler will set up an intimate candlelit table on your beachfront terrace, decorated with tropical flowers. A private chef will prepare a bespoke three-course dinner tailored to your preferences — think Maldivian spiced crab bisque, grilled whole snapper with saffron butter, and a decadent dark chocolate fondant with vanilla ice cream.

meals.breakfast: Healthy wellness breakfast post-yoga — green smoothies, acai bowls, granola, fresh tropical fruit
meals.lunch: Gourmet picnic-style lunch served on the catamaran during the snorkeling safari — sandwiches, wraps, fresh fruit, chilled sparkling water and juices
meals.dinner: Private beachfront in-villa dinner by personal chef — crab bisque, grilled snapper, dark chocolate fondant

day_by_day.notes: Book the Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari at least 48 hours in advance through the resort concierge. Confirm manta ray season (typically May–November in Baa Atoll) — March may offer excellent visibility with varied marine life. Apply reef-safe sunscreen only.

day_by_day.morning: Wake up early for a sunrise kayaking adventure through the resort's calm lagoon. Paddle through mangrove channels and spot seabirds, juvenile reef fish, and the stunning dawn colours reflecting on the water. Return to the resort for a lavish buffet breakfast at the main restaurant, featuring live cooking stations, international and Maldivian dishes, fresh pastries, and premium cold cuts.
day_by_day.afternoon: Embark on the Maldivian Cooking Class & Local Island Visit — take a short boat ride to the inhabited local island of Maafushi. Explore the island's narrow streets, colourful local homes, and a traditional mosque. Then join a hands-on cooking class led by a local Maldivian family, learning to prepare authentic dishes such as mas huni (smoked tuna with coconut), garudhiya (tuna broth), and hedhikaa (local snacks). Return to the resort with newfound culinary skills and local spice souvenirs.
day_by_day.evening: Unwind with sundowner cocktails on your private beachfront terrace. Dine at the resort's overwater restaurant, perched above the lagoon with glass floor panels revealing the marine life below. Enjoy a seafood-forward à la carte dinner — Maldivian lobster thermidor, seared scallops, and a deconstructed coconut tart — accompanied by a sommelier-curated wine pairing.

meals.breakfast: Lavish resort buffet — live cooking stations, Maldivian and international dishes, pastries, premium cold cuts
meals.lunch: Authentic Maldivian lunch on Maafushi island as part of the cooking class experience — mas huni, garudhiya, hedhikaa
meals.dinner: Overwater restaurant à la carte — lobster thermidor, seared scallops, coconut tart with sommelier wine pairing

day_by_day.notes: The local island visit requires modest dress (shoulders and knees covered) out of respect for local customs — pack a light scarf or sarong. The cooking class is typically 2–3 hours and highly interactive. Pre-book through the resort concierge.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a slow, indulgent morning in your villa. Order a personalised à la carte in-villa breakfast at your preferred time. Spend the late morning lounging on your private beach, reading, or taking a refreshing dip in your plunge pool. Optional: visit the resort's boutique for Maldivian handicrafts, luxury swimwear, and locally crafted souvenirs.
day_by_day.afternoon: Participate in the resort's guided dolphin-watching excursion aboard a luxury speedboat. Head to the open ocean where spinner dolphins are frequently spotted leaping and playing in the bow waves. The trip includes complimentary snorkeling at a pristine outer reef drop-off with exceptional visibility, where you may encounter large pelagic fish, eagle rays, and vibrant coral walls. Chilled beverages and fresh fruit are served on board.
day_by_day.evening: Tonight, experience the Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise — embark on a traditional Maldivian wooden dhoni decorated with tropical flowers, lanterns, and candles. As the sun sets over the Indian Ocean, enjoy a curated selection of canapés (smoked salmon blinis, prawn cocktail, bruschetta), chilled champagne, and a bespoke cocktail menu. Watch the sky turn golden while floating on calm, glittering waters — an unmissable honeymoon highlight.

meals.breakfast: Personalised in-villa à la carte breakfast — eggs any style, freshly baked bread, tropical fruit platter, premium coffee
meals.lunch: Light beachside lunch — grilled tiger prawns, watermelon and feta salad, fresh coconut
meals.dinner: Canapés and champagne on the Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise, followed by a late dinner at the resort's beach bar — wood-fired pizza, artisan charcuterie boards, craft cocktails

day_by_day.notes: The Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise must be pre-booked and is weather-dependent. Timing is approximately 1.5–2 hours and is best scheduled around 30 minutes before sunset. Bring a light wrap for the sea breeze.

day_by_day.morning: Begin the day with a guided stand-up paddleboarding (SUP) lesson in the calm resort lagoon, followed by a freestyle session at your own pace. The glassy morning water is ideal for beginners and offers stunning views of the overwater bungalows and surrounding reef. Freshen up and enjoy a healthy breakfast at the resort's wellness café — cold-pressed juices, avocado toast, poached eggs, and superfood bowls.
day_by_day.afternoon: Indulge in an extended couples' spa journey at the Aqua Spa. Begin with a traditional Maldivian scrub using coconut husk and sea salt, followed by a 90-minute hot stone therapy massage in a private overwater treatment room with floor panels revealing the ocean below. Conclude with a floral bath ritual drawn with local frangipani blossoms and essential oils, sipping herbal teas on your spa terrace.
day_by_day.evening: Dine at the Underwater Restaurant for Two — one of the world's most iconic dining experiences. Surrounded by panoramic floor-to-ceiling acrylic walls, watch reef sharks, rays, and thousands of tropical fish glide past as you savour a bespoke seven-course tasting menu crafted by the resort's executive chef. Expect dishes such as Maldivian tuna ceviche, butter-poached lobster, and a signature 'ocean' dessert platter. Premium wine and champagne pairings available.

meals.breakfast: Wellness café — cold-pressed juices, avocado toast, poached eggs, superfood bowls
meals.lunch: Light spa lunch served on the spa terrace — mezze platter, hummus, grilled vegetables, sparkling water with botanicals
meals.dinner: Underwater Restaurant — seven-course tasting menu with optional champagne and wine pairing (tuna ceviche, butter-poached lobster, ocean dessert platter)

day_by_day.notes: The Underwater Restaurant is one of the most sought-after experiences — book well in advance (ideally at the time of resort reservation). Dress code is smart casual. The experience typically lasts 2.5–3 hours.

day_by_day.morning: Celebrate the midpoint of your honeymoon with a private sunrise fishing experience aboard a traditional dhoni with an experienced local fisherman. Learn traditional Maldivian hand-line fishing techniques in the early morning calm. Any catch can be brought back to the resort's kitchen and prepared as a personalised lunch. Return to the resort for a freshly prepared continental breakfast on your villa terrace.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend a leisurely afternoon at the resort's infinity pool, which appears to merge seamlessly with the ocean horizon. Enjoy premium pool service — chilled towels, signature cocktails, fresh fruit skewers, and gourmet snacks delivered to your sun lounger. Optional: book a 30-minute private jet ski excursion around the resort's lagoon for an adrenaline boost.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic beachfront bonfire dinner arranged by your butler on a secluded stretch of private beach. Tiki torches and lanterns light the scene as a private waiter serves a bespoke grilled seafood feast — whole grilled lobster, tiger prawns, reef fish, and seasonal vegetables, accompanied by a chilled bottle of vintage Chablis. End the evening stargazing on the beach with your butler providing a telescope and constellation guide.

meals.breakfast: Continental breakfast on villa terrace — croissants, jams, tropical fruits, yogurt, premium coffee and tea
meals.lunch: Personalised lunch at the resort kitchen featuring your morning catch — grilled fish with local spices, coconut rice, fresh salad
meals.dinner: Private beachfront bonfire dinner — whole grilled lobster, tiger prawns, reef fish, vintage Chablis

day_by_day.notes: The private bonfire beach dinner requires advance arrangement with your butler (minimum 24 hours). The fishing excursion begins at approximately 05:30–06:00 to catch sunrise — confirm timing the evening before.

day_by_day.morning: Explore the resort's marine education centre, where the resident marine biologist hosts an engaging presentation on Maldivian coral reef ecosystems, conservation efforts, and the resort's coral planting programme. Participate in the resort's coral restoration activity — plant your own coral fragment onto a reef frame that will be tagged with your names and monitored for years to come, a meaningful and lasting honeymoon memento.
day_by_day.afternoon: Embark on a half-day private snorkeling excursion to a remote, uninhabited sandbank. A resort boat will take you to a pristine outer reef renowned for exceptional marine diversity. Snorkel alongside hawksbill sea turtles, reef sharks, and vibrant coral formations. Stop at the sandbank for a private champagne and canapé picnic — just the two of you on a tiny strip of white sand surrounded by the Indian Ocean.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort refreshed and sun-kissed. Enjoy pre-dinner drinks at the resort's rooftop sky bar, offering 360-degree panoramic views of the atoll as the stars begin to appear. Dine at the resort's Japanese-Maldivian fusion restaurant — an omakase-style menu featuring premium sashimi, miso-glazed black cod, wagyu beef tataki, and matcha mochi ice cream, with an extensive sake and cocktail menu.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast — eggs Benedict, smoked salmon, freshly baked sourdough, tropical fruit, fresh juices
meals.lunch: Private sandbank champagne picnic — smoked salmon blinis, artisan cheeses, charcuterie, fresh fruit, Moët & Chandon
meals.dinner: Japanese-Maldivian fusion restaurant — omakase menu with sake pairing (sashimi, miso black cod, wagyu tataki, matcha mochi)

day_by_day.notes: The coral planting activity is a meaningful eco-luxury experience — request a personalised certificate from the resort. The remote sandbank excursion is weather-dependent; confirm availability the morning of.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a guided birdwatching walk through the resort's lush tropical gardens and mangrove edges, led by a naturalist guide. Spot endemic Maldivian species such as the white tern, grey heron, and Indian pond heron. Return for a leisurely brunch at the resort's main restaurant — a lavish spread of eggs stations, fresh seafood, salads, and Maldivian specialties.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enjoy an afternoon of pure relaxation and luxury. Rent a private glass-bottom kayak and paddle over the house reef, watching the marine world below without getting wet. Alternatively, simply laze on your beachfront villa's private stretch of sand with butler-delivered afternoon tea — finger sandwiches, scones with clotted cream and jam, petit fours, and premium loose-leaf teas.
day_by_day.evening: Tonight, experience the Bioluminescent Beach Night Experience — after dark, travel by boat to a secluded beach where the shoreline glows with stunning blue bioluminescent plankton. Walk barefoot along the glowing shoreline, creating magical trails of light with every step. A guide will explain the science behind this natural phenomenon. Return to the resort for a nightcap of aged rum and dark chocolate at the beach bar.

meals.breakfast: Lavish resort brunch — eggs station, fresh seafood, Maldivian specialties, pastries, tropical juices
meals.lunch: Beachfront afternoon tea — finger sandwiches, scones with clotted cream, petit fours, premium loose-leaf teas
meals.dinner: Light dinner at the resort's beach bar before the bioluminescence excursion — grilled fish tacos, prawn skewers, craft cocktails; nightcap of aged rum and dark chocolate on return

day_by_day.notes: The Bioluminescent Beach Night Experience on Vaadhoo Island is weather and season dependent — bioluminescence is most vivid on moonless nights. Confirm the lunar calendar in advance and book through the resort concierge. Wear dark clothing to enhance the visual effect.

day_by_day.morning: Dedicate the morning to a comprehensive water sports adventure. Begin with a tandem parasailing flight over the resort's lagoon for breathtaking aerial views of the turquoise waters and coral reefs. Follow with a guided wakeboarding or water skiing session behind the resort's speedboat. All equipment and instruction are provided by certified water sports staff.
day_by_day.afternoon: Wind down with a peaceful afternoon at the resort's adults-only pool and cabana area. Reserve a private poolside cabana with personalised butler service, chilled champagne, fruit platters, and a dedicated attendant. Optional: enjoy a 45-minute reflexology foot massage in the cabana. Spend the late afternoon reading, napping, and soaking in the serene atmosphere.
day_by_day.evening: Celebrate your tenth evening with a special honeymoon dinner arranged by the resort — a fully personalised, exclusive chef's table experience in the resort's private wine cellar. Seat just the two of you amid hundreds of premium wine bottles, as the executive chef presents a bespoke five-course menu inspired by your personal preferences. The sommelier will guide you through a curated wine pairing for each course.

meals.breakfast: In-villa floating pool breakfast — pancakes with fresh berries, smoked salmon bagels, fresh juices, cappuccino
meals.lunch: Poolside cabana lunch — gourmet club sandwiches, lobster rolls, fresh fruit, sparkling water and cocktails
meals.dinner: Private chef's table in the wine cellar — personalised five-course menu with curated wine pairing by the resort sommelier

day_by_day.notes: The private chef's table wine cellar experience is an exclusive offering — book well in advance and provide dietary preferences and favourite cuisines to the concierge so the chef can craft a truly personalised menu.

day_by_day.morning: Embark on a full-day private island hopping excursion aboard the resort's luxury yacht. The first stop is a pristine uninhabited island for a morning snorkeling session at an untouched reef. Explore the island's interior, collect seashells along the shoreline, and enjoy the complete solitude of a deserted paradise.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the yacht journey to a second island location for a gourmet picnic lunch served on the beach by the yacht's onboard steward. Snorkel the afternoon reef, known for its resident nurse sharks and sea turtle cleaning stations. Enjoy sundowners on the yacht's deck as you cruise back toward the resort, watching the sunset paint the sky.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort refreshed and sun-kissed. Enjoy a casual, relaxed evening — a long shower, in-villa couple's massage (arranged with the spa team), and a cosy in-villa dinner. Your butler will set up a movie night on the villa's outdoor terrace with a projector, bean bags, blankets, and a gourmet snack spread — popcorn, sliders, truffle fries, and a bottle of fine red wine.

meals.breakfast: On the yacht — continental spread of croissants, fruits, yogurt, cheeses, fresh juices, and coffee prepared by the yacht steward
meals.lunch: Private beach gourmet picnic — lobster sandwiches, charcuterie, tropical fruit, chilled rosé champagne
meals.dinner: In-villa outdoor movie night dinner — gourmet sliders, truffle fries, artisan popcorn, fine red wine

day_by_day.notes: The private yacht excursion is a full-day commitment (approximately 8–10 hours). Bring reef-safe sunscreen, hats, and light cover-ups. The resort can arrange a customised route based on marine life sightings and weather conditions.

day_by_day.morning: Spend your penultimate morning revisiting your favourite spot — the house reef for a final snorkeling session. Take your time exploring the coral gardens one last time, saying farewell to the sea turtles, reef fish, and rays that have become familiar companions throughout the trip. Return for a leisurely in-villa breakfast and a long, relaxing soak in the villa's outdoor bathtub.
day_by_day.afternoon: Treat yourselves to a final indulgent spa afternoon — a full 3-hour couples' luxury ritual at the Aqua Spa. The journey includes a full-body exfoliation, a traditional Maldivian boreh wrap (using local spices and coconut), a 90-minute signature couples' massage, and a private Jacuzzi session overlooking the ocean. Conclude with a personalised skincare consultation and take-home product set as a spa gift.
day_by_day.evening: For your final full evening, the resort arranges a bespoke farewell honeymoon dinner on a private overwater platform, decorated with thousands of floating candles, tropical flowers, and fairy lights. A live acoustic musician plays softly in the background as you enjoy a five-course seafood extravaganza — Maldivian tuna tartare, butter-poached lobster bisque, grilled whole reef fish, cheese selection, and a custom honeymoon cake crafted by the resort's pastry chef. A bottle of vintage Dom Pérignon is presented as a complimentary farewell gift from the resort.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely in-villa breakfast — eggs any style, fresh pastries, tropical fruit platter, fresh juices, barista coffee
